hooks.command: payload=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id'); skill=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty'); if [ "$skill" = "code-review" ] && [ -n "$sid" ]; then touch "/tmp/claude-code-review-$sid.done"; fi

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id'); if [ -f "/tmp/claude-code-review-$sid.done" ]; then echo '{"continue": true}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run /code-review on this diff before opening a PR — no code review has been recorded yet this session."}}'; fi

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id'); if [ -f "/tmp/claude-code-review-$sid.done" ]; then echo '{"continue": true}'; else echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Run /code-review on this diff before opening a PR — no code review has been recorded yet this session."}'; fi
